title: No autoplay prevents playback (avc-50fps-cbr-hd)
product-requirement: Client must not autoplay when the autoplay property is not set.
specification: Terminals MUST implement Media Source Extensions API (https://www.w3.org/TR/media-source-2/).
assertion: Media playback does not start automatically. MediaSource and MediaElement events must emit in expected order, and properties must be of expected values.
